newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade light $65, off $1-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade light $65, off $1-USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt lower, USDA said.

Inquiry moderate, demand light. Sales confirmed on 800 slaughter steers and 1,300 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 13,200 head confirmed including 5,600 previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1225 lbs 65.00. Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1125 lbs 65.00; Select with end Choice 1075-1150 lbs 65.00; mixed Commercial to Choice 1175-1200 lb heifers, heiferettes and cows 65.00.
Wk to date - 13,200 last week - 88,000 last year - 24,000
